$\text{cyclopentanone ring}=\text{CH-Ph}$

Both $E$ and $Z$ isomers are possible, corresponding to the two drawn alkene arrangements.

Similarly, condensation with another ketone gives an $\alpha,\beta$-unsaturated carbonyl compound, i.e. the new double bond must be conjugated with the carbonyl group.

Hence structures of the type shown in options $1$, $2$ and $3$ are obtainable as aldol condensation products, whereas option $4$ is not an $\alpha,\beta$-unsaturated carbonyl compound and therefore cannot be formed by the given aldol condensation.

Therefore, compound $4$ cannot be obtained by aldol condensation of the given compounds.
